upstream_plugins.name: Omarchy Lacquer
upstream_plugins.description: One app for how your Omarchy desktop looks. Themes, wallpapers, shuffle and theme generation with a readability check; saved looks you can carry to another machine; fonts, text rendering, icons and the mouse pointer; window shape, borders built from your theme, glass, shadow and the colour behind your windows; one motion feel or every animation on its own; screens, night light, lock and boot; bar and menu style; per-app rules; terminals, btop and every plugin. 370 settings in plain words, live.

upstream_plugins.name: Argus
upstream_plugins.description: CPU, RAM, GPU, disk, network, battery, power, and temperature stats in the bar, with a full system panel: 2m/1h/24h history that survives restarts (the flight recorder), per-metric opt-in alerts with context snapshots, a filterable sortable process table, per-process GPU usage, drive SMART health, an alert hook for automation, and a GAME tab that configures your MangoHud in-game overlay live.
